nora: Quick heads-up: TAQS (Throughput-Aware QuantSwitch) is on canary for the microkernel fleet.
nora: Short summary: runtime dynamically switches between two execution paths per request: fast-quant kernel for short-context/high-throughput, and high-fidelity kernel for long-context/streaming. The switcher uses a tiny runtime heuristic (early-token-rate + predicted tail-length).

devon: Nice. Real numbers?

bench-bot: Canary comparison @ 5% traffic (shard-a): p50 latency -28%, p95 -19%, p99 -26ms, token-cost -20.4% vs baseline. Throughput on small-window workloads improved ~24%.

devon: Which models and test workloads?

nora: Models: rw-7b-quant-hybrid, redwood/4k-q, and rw-13b in float32 path. Workloads: chat short answers, search snippets, and longer streamy summarization templates. We also ran synthetic replay with top-20 templates.

kai: Any quality diffs? switching kernels could change logits.

nora: Ran 2k evals across QA, summarization, and API fuzz tests. Aggregate quality delta within +/-0.3% across our metrics. For tail-sensitive prompts we pin to high-fidelity path. Added conservative fallback: if token-entropy delta > 0.6% for a given prompt group, auto-route that group to hf-kernel for the rollout.

deploy-bot: Canary finished 1755554350. Health checks: OK. Perf summary posted to canary dashboard.

sam: rollout plan?

nora: Staged rollout: 5% -> 15% (6h) -> 40% (18h) -> 80% (36h) -> 100% (72h) with automated quality/latency gates. Ops alerted.

ops-bot: Added monitors: `taqs.p99_latency`, `taqs.token_cost_delta`, `taqs.quality_entropy_delta`. Alerts: fire if p99 > baseline+45ms for 5m or entropy_delta > 0.6% for 10m.

devon: Config snippet and PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/8015

devon: ```
kernel_switcher:
  strategy: taqs-v1
  threshold:
    token_rate: 12  # tokens/sec
    pred_tail: 40   # tokens
  hf_route: hf-kernel-v2
  fast_route: quant-kernel-v4
  fallback: hf-kernel-v2
```

nora: Tagging @kai @sam to run post-rollout smoke + edge-case tests (streaming partials, logit diffs). Reminder: update runbooks and support FAQ about why some sessions change behavior mid-stream.

kai: Will run the smoke suite and post results. Great work team :tada:

nora: I'll collate graphs and a short write-up for #eng-runtime tomorrow with per-model breakdowns.
